title: Heat Loss Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the rate of heat loss through the insulation as 114 W.

title: Entropy Change Water
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the entropy change of the hot water as -0.314 W/K.

title: Entropy Change Room
description: Essential Criteria: The student must find the entropy change of the room as 0.403 W/K.

title: Entropy Change Universe
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the total entropy change of the universe as 0.089 W/K.

title: Correct Use of Formulas
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the formulas for heat transfer and entropy change.

title: Temperature Consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student must use consistent temperature values for calculations.

title: Unit Accuracy
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure all units are correctly used and converted where necessary.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the calculations of heat loss and entropy changes.

title: Neglecting Insulation Effects
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not neglect the effects of insulation on heat transfer.
